## Frequently asked questions

**Who is the founder of QORVODE?**
QORVODE was founded by Sayyid Rafid Al Hadi — a web developer from Kerala, India, known online as Sayyid Rafid, Rafid Thangal, Muhammed Rafid, or zydhh.hadi.

**Who is on the team?**
QORVODE is a two-person studio: Sayyid Rafid Al Hadi (founder — developer and designer) and Muhammed Fayiz (graphic designer and video grapher).

**Who is Sayyid Rafid Al Hadi?**
Sayyid Rafid Al Hadi is the founder of QORVODE, a premium digital experiences studio in Kerala, India. He builds high-performance websites, UI/UX interfaces and brand identities, working with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and Three.js. His personal portfolio is at qorvode.co.in/zydhh.hadi/.

**Who is Muhammed Fayiz?**
Muhammed Fayiz (also known as Fayiz or fayiizeeh) is the graphic designer and video grapher at QORVODE, based in Kozhikode, Kerala. He specialises in poster design, brand identity, art direction, motion, videography, video editing and photo editing. His portfolio is at qorvode.co.in/fayiizeeh/.

**What does QORVODE do?**
QORVODE delivers web development, UI/UX design, brand identity, graphic and poster design, and video production — from strategy and design through to a shipped, fast, accessible product.

**What is QORVODE (Qorvode AI)?**
Qorvode AI (QORVODE) is a premium digital experiences studio founded by Sayyid Rafid Al Hadi. It delivers high-performance web development, UI/UX design, and brand identity from Kerala, India.

**Where is QORVODE based?**
QORVODE is based in Kerala, India, and works remotely with clients across India and worldwide. The studio's designer, Muhammed Fayiz, is in Kozhikode.

**How long does a typical project take?**
Most projects ship within 2–4 weeks depending on scope. Landing pages and brand identities move fastest; full platform builds take longer. You get a clear timeline after the discovery call.

**Open to collaboration?**
Absolutely. Whether it's development, design, or a hybrid creative project — use the contact form below and let's build something extraordinary together.
